description:
Yeon, who had nothing, now has two things he had never had before. One is Mu-Jin, who gives Yeon a warmth he never felt before and then takes it away. The other is Seoljunghongok, a rare jewel ambitiously prepared by the Demonic Cult. When he learns of the Hongok’s ability to easily absorb the opponent’s internal energy with just his pretty face, the former becomes Yeon’s goal, and the latter becomes Yeon’s means. Yeon swallows Seoljunghongok without hesitation. And he realizes it. If he really had this bead, even he, who came from a poor family, could build martial arts skills that no one would envy. Yeon immediately goes to face the famous masters of the Jeongpa. He must dream of a better future? He now chews on the words Mu-Jin told him in order to get revenge on him. However, what Yeon realizes through that adventure is none other than the preciousness of his comrades by his side. His deep affection for Mu-Jin cannot be erased no matter how much he tries to deny it. However, he cannot easily stop now, no matter how much he tries to. Because in the past, Yeon has crossed too many lines and made too many people his enemy.

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)
